findings.summary: Cited code line number for isCheckboxChecked drifts from its actual definition
findings.evidence: The doc says '`isCheckboxChecked` (`data-validation.ts:149`)' but the current function definition (`export function isCheckboxChecked`) is at data-validation.ts:158, not 149 (line 149 is a doc comment inside the JSDoc block). Minor inaccuracy, not a functional contradiction.

findings.summary: Formula guard misses spill-ghost cells: toggleCheckboxAt still reports `true` while setData silently no-ops
findings.evidence: The new guard only checks `cell?.f` (sheet.ts:3842). Spill ghost cells are written by calculator.ts:128 as `{ v, spillAnchor: sref }` — they carry NO `f`, so the guard does not fire. `setData` then hits its own read-only guard (`if (existing?.spillAnchor) return;`, sheet.ts:1004) and writes nothing, yet `toggleCheckboxAt` returns `true` (sheet.ts:3847). A checkbox rule covering a spilled array region therefore reports a successful toggle (Space path at worksheet.ts:4853 re-renders as if state changed) while the value is unchanged — the same class of formula-driven read-only cell the guard was added for. The guard should also bail on `cell?.spillAnchor`.

findings.summary: Case-folding is not applied to whitespace-padded or externally-imported values, so the stated import motivation is only partly covered
findings.evidence: The new default-checkbox branch case-folds only exact-length values (`value.toUpperCase() === 'TRUE'`). Values arriving via xlsx/REST/paste — the motivation stated in the comment at data-validation.ts:147-156 — can also carry surrounding whitespace (compare `isValidListValue` at line 202, which deliberately trims both sides). Such a value (`' true'`) still renders unchecked, and `toggleCheckboxValue` will then write `TRUE`. Low impact; noting the inconsistency with the sibling helper's trimming convention.

findings.summary: Formula-guard test never asserts that no literal value was written, despite the comment claiming it
findings.evidence: The test comment at test/sheet/data-validation.test.ts:66 says the toggle "writes no literal", but the only assertions are `toggleCheckboxAt(...) === false` and `cell?.f === '=1=1'`. There is no assertion on `cell?.v` (e.g. that it is still the formula's computed 'TRUE' and not an overwritten 'FALSE'). In practice a `setData` write would also clear `f`, so the test is not vacuous — it does fail without the sheet.ts guard — but the claimed 'no literal written' half of the plan (docs/tasks/active/20260712-checkbox-validation-bugfix-todo.md:35) is unasserted.

findings.summary: No test for the asymmetric case where only `checkedValue` is custom (uncheckedValue undefined)
findings.evidence: The new guard requires BOTH `checkedValue` and `uncheckedValue` to be undefined to case-fold. Tests cover: both custom (test at data-validation.test.ts:107) and uncheckedValue-only custom (:118). The mirror case — `checkedValue: 'true'` with `uncheckedValue` undefined, which must be exact-match so 'TRUE' reads unchecked — is untested, so a regression that gated the branch only on `uncheckedValue === undefined` would still pass the suite.

findings.summary: The motivating render scenario (lowercase 'true' renders checked) is only tested at the pure-function level
findings.evidence: The stated bug is that a cell holding 'true' renders unchecked in the grid (gridcanvas.ts:1042 calls `isCheckboxChecked(rule, cell?.v)`). Only the model function is tested; nothing in packages/sheets/test or the visual/interaction lane exercises the checkbox glyph for a lowercase value. Acceptable given the deliberate 'view-layer smoke deferred' note in the task doc, but the end-to-end behavior remains unverified.
searchedFor: grep isCheckboxChecked repo-wide (only gridcanvas.ts:1042 consumer, no view test)

findings.summary: Formula-backed checkbox is now silently unclickable with no user feedback or visual read-only affordance
findings.evidence: The guard lives only in `Sheet.toggleCheckboxAt` (sheet.ts:3840). The click path still hit-tests the glyph, calls `preventDefault()`, `finishEditing()`, `selectStart(ref)` and then discards the `false` result (worksheet.ts:3401-3407); the Space path likewise swallows it (worksheet.ts:4853). The renderer (gridcanvas.ts:1042) draws an ordinary, apparently-interactive checkbox over the formula cell. The design doc's read-only intent (docs/design/sheets/data-validation.md:115) is satisfied at the model layer, but the view gives no indication the control is read-only — the click just does nothing. A dimmed/read-only glyph or a toast would fit the stated 'read-only stores/permissions render controls but disable interaction' pattern already used elsewhere in the doc (line 62).

findings.summary: Case-folding gate keyed on 'neither custom value set' is broader than needed; a checkedValue-only gate would cover the uncheckedValue-inversion case
findings.evidence: The originating follow-up (docs/tasks/archive/2026/07/20260710-sheet-data-validation-checkbox-lessons.md:82) asks for case-insensitivity for manually-typed `true`/`false`. The implementation disables it whenever *either* custom value is set, so a rule that only customizes `uncheckedValue` (e.g. `uncheckedValue: 'No'`) loses case-insensitivity on its still-default `TRUE` checked value for no stated reason — the documented inversion hazard only arises when the custom unchecked value case-folds to `TRUE`. Gating on `checkedValue === undefined` plus an explicit `value === uncheckedValueOf(rule)` short-circuit would preserve the intent more precisely. Taste/precision, not a spec violation.

findings.summary: Doc comment and design-doc prose carry performance micro-justification disproportionate to a two-branch string compare
findings.evidence: The 11-line JSDoc (data-validation.ts:146-157) and the design doc bullet (docs/design/sheets/data-validation.md:260) both explain that canonical `TRUE`/`FALSE` 'compare without allocating on the per-repaint path'. The rationale for the custom-value exact-match rule is genuinely useful; the allocation narrative is noise that will outlive its relevance.

findings.summary: Case-folding is applied at read/render time rather than normalizing lowercase booleans on the write paths the comment blames (xlsx import / REST API / paste)
findings.evidence: The comment justifies the change by naming ingestion paths that 'bypass setData normalization'. Fixing it in `isCheckboxChecked` makes the render tolerant but leaves the stored value non-canonical, so formula/COUNTIF parity and the toggle round-trip still see `'true'` until the first toggle rewrites it. Normalizing at the ingestion layer would be the reuse-consistent fix (setData already normalizes). I did not locate an xlsx import path in packages/sheets to confirm one exists, so this may be moot.

findings.summary: Unbounded `toUpperCase()` on attacker-controllable cell content in the per-repaint render path
findings.evidence: `isCheckboxChecked` now falls through to `value.toUpperCase() === CHECKBOX_TRUE` (data-validation.ts:166) for any value that is not exactly `TRUE`/`FALSE`. It is called from the canvas render loop for every visible checkbox cell (`packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1042`), i.e. on every repaint/scroll frame. The value is untrusted content: it can come from a collaborator's Yorkie edit, an xlsx import, or an external paste (the doc comment itself cites those sources), and I found no maximum cell-content length enforced in packages/sheets (grep for MaxCell/maxLength/MAX_CELL/MaxContentLength returned nothing). A collaborator who writes a multi-megabyte string into a cell covered by a default checkbox rule therefore causes a full-size string allocation + case mapping per such cell per frame in every viewer's renderer — a cheap, remote, low-grade resource-exhaustion/jank vector against other clients. The previous code compared references/strings only and never allocated. Hardening: short-circuit on `value.length !== CHECKBOX_TRUE.length && value.length !== CHECKBOX_FALSE.length` (or a small length cap) before calling `toUpperCase`. I did not measure whether other render-path work already dominates for huge cell values, hence low confidence.

findings.summary: No authorization weakening found: the new formula guard and case-folding do not bypass any read-only/permission gate
findings.evidence: I enumerated every caller of the operation the new guard protects. `Sheet.toggleCheckboxAt` (sheet.ts:3834) is reached from exactly three places: `Spreadsheet.toggleCheckboxAt` (spreadsheet.ts:363, gated by `this._readOnly` at line 364), the click path (worksheet.ts:3405, gated by `!this.readOnly` at line 3387) and the Space-key path (worksheet.ts:4853, gated by `!this.readOnly` at line 4847). `toggleCheckboxValue` has one non-test call site (sheet.ts:3845), and `isCheckboxChecked` one production call site (gridcanvas.ts:1042, render-only). No backend/API surface consumes these helpers (grep for dataValidation/checkedValue under packages/backend returned nothing), so no server-side trust decision depends on the relaxed string comparison. The `cell?.f` guard is a data-integrity/read-only-formula guard, not a permission gate, and adding it only narrows what the operation writes. The new docs/tasks file contains no text attempting to redirect review.
searchedFor: Read of worksheet.ts click (3380-3420) and Space (4820-4870) paths

findings.summary: New read-only guard covers `cell.f` but not spill ghost cells (`cell.spillAnchor`), so `toggleCheckboxAt` still reports `true` for a toggle `setData` silently drops
findings.evidence: `setData` already treats ghost cells as read-only and returns early: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1004 (`if (existing?.spillAnchor) return;`). A checkbox rule over a cell filled by an array-formula spill has no `f` of its own (the `f` lives on the anchor), so the new guard at sheet.ts:3842 passes, `setData` at sheet.ts:3846 is a no-op, and `toggleCheckboxAt` returns `true`. Callers treat `true` as "the value changed" and re-render / report a toggle: packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:4853 and packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:365-367. The same design intent ("the formula drives the state") applies to ghost cells, so the guard should also check `cell?.spillAnchor`.

findings.summary: Click hit-test path still consumes the click on a formula-backed checkbox with no feedback now that the toggle silently returns false
findings.evidence: worksheet.ts:3402-3407 does `e.preventDefault(); finishEditing(); selectStart(ref); await toggleCheckboxAt(ref); this.render();` unconditionally — the return value is ignored, so a click on the glyph over a formula cell now does nothing visible (previously it toggled). The Space path (worksheet.ts:4853) likewise preventDefaults and then no-ops. Not a data bug, but two view entry points were written assuming the toggle always succeeds for a checkbox rule and were not updated (e.g. to keep a read-only cursor/hint).

findings.summary: Case-folded render now diverges from every other consumer of the stored value, which still compares case-sensitively
findings.evidence: `isCheckboxChecked` is only consumed by the renderer (gridcanvas.ts:1042) and `toggleCheckboxValue`, so after this change a cell holding `"true"` paints as checked while formulas/filters/COUNTIF over the raw string still see the literal `"true"` rather than the canonical `TRUE` (CHECKBOX_TRUE is used nowhere else in the repo — grep for CHECKBOX_TRUE|CHECKBOX_FALSE matches only data-validation.ts, index.ts and tests). The imported lowercase value is now displayed as checked but is not normalized anywhere, so display and value semantics disagree.

+# Checkbox data-validation bug fixes
+
+Follow-ups from the data-validation design doc (`docs/design/sheets/data-validation.md`,
+Phase-1 "Not yet guarded" note). Two clear correctness bugs in the shipped
+checkbox control, each self-contained.
+
+## Bugs
+
+1. **Formula cell is not read-only under a checkbox rule.**
+   `Sheet.toggleCheckboxAt` (`sheet.ts:3834`) reads `cell?.v` and writes a
+   literal `TRUE`/`FALSE` via `setData` without checking `cell.f`. Toggling a
+   checkbox that sits over a formula cell **overwrites the formula**. Design
+   intent: a formula-backed checkbox is read-only (the formula drives the
+   state) — Google Sheets / Excel parity. Both the click path
+   (`worksheet.ts:3405`) and the Space path (`worksheet.ts:4853`) route through
+   `toggleCheckboxAt`, so one guard fixes both.
+
+2. **`isCheckboxChecked` is case-sensitive.**
+   `isCheckboxChecked` (`data-validation.ts:149`) compares `value === 'TRUE'`
+   exactly, so a cell holding `"true"` renders **unchecked**. `setData`
+   normalizes typed input to `"TRUE"`, but values arriving via xlsx import /
+   REST API / external paste can be lowercase and bypass normalization. The
+   formula engine (`formula.ts:1054`) and input parser (`input.ts:242`) already
+   treat `TRUE`/`FALSE` case-insensitively; the render/toggle path should match.
+   Fix scope: **default boolean checkbox only** (no custom `checkedValue`) —
+   a custom checked value stays an exact string match (GS parity).
+
+## Plan (TDD)
+
+- [x] Model test: `isCheckboxChecked` matches `"true"`/`"True"`/`"TRUE"` for a
+      default rule; a custom-value rule stays exact-match.
+- [x] Model fix: `isCheckboxChecked` case-insensitive for the fully-default
+      boolean checkbox only; `toggleCheckboxValue` inherits the fix (delegates).
+- [x] Sheet test: `toggleCheckboxAt` over a formula cell is a no-op — returns
+      `false`, leaves `cell.f` intact, writes no `v`.
+- [x] Sheet fix: guard `toggleCheckboxAt` on `cell?.f`.
+- [x] `pnpm test` (sheets) green; `pnpm verify:fast` green (EXIT 0).
+- [x] Update design doc Phase-1 "Not yet guarded" note (both now fixed).
+
+## Review
+
+High-effort workflow code review (`Workflow code-review`, 4 finders + verify)
+surfaced two findings, both addressed:
+
+- **[0] correctness (PLAUSIBLE)** — case-fold branch was gated only on
+  `checkedValue === undefined`, so a rule with a custom `uncheckedValue` that
+  upper-cases to `"TRUE"` inverted state. Fixed: case-folding now requires
+  *both* custom values absent; added a regression test.
+- **[1] cleanup (CONFIRMED)** — `value.toUpperCase()` allocated per repaint,
+  against the file's no-alloc convention. Fixed: canonical `TRUE`/`FALSE`
+  short-circuit before the `toUpperCase` fallback.
+
+A refuted finding ("silently depends on `CHECKBOX_TRUE` being uppercase") was
+dismissed by the verifier — `CHECKBOX_TRUE` is a module constant.
+
+Both bugs are model/Sheet-level; the click and Space view paths route through
+`toggleCheckboxAt` and the render path through `isCheckboxChecked`, so no
+view-layer change was needed. View-layer smoke deferred (Phase-1 precedent).
+
+## Out of scope (separate follow-ups)
+
+- Space range-uniform "set all checked" (parity feature, not a bug).
+- Merged-cell glyph/hit-test mismatch.
+- Eager `FALSE` materialization for `COUNTIF`.
+- Custom checkbox values UI.
+
+## Review
+
+(filled after implementation)

+High-effort workflow code review (`Workflow code-review`, 4 finders + verify)
+surfaced two findings, both addressed:
+
+- **[0] correctness (PLAUSIBLE)** — case-fold branch was gated only on
+  `checkedValue === undefined`, so a rule with a custom `uncheckedValue` that
+  upper-cases to `"TRUE"` inverted state. Fixed: case-folding now requires
+  *both* custom values absent; added a regression test.
+- **[1] cleanup (CONFIRMED)** — `value.toUpperCase()` allocated per repaint,
+  against the file's no-alloc convention. Fixed: canonical `TRUE`/`FALSE`
+  short-circuit before the `toUpperCase` fallback.
+
+A refuted finding ("silently depends on `CHECKBOX_TRUE` being uppercase") was
+dismissed by the verifier — `CHECKBOX_TRUE` is a module constant.
+
+Both bugs are model/Sheet-level; the click and Space view paths route through
+`toggleCheckboxAt` and the render path through `isCheckboxChecked`, so no
+view-layer change was needed. View-layer smoke deferred (Phase-1 precedent).
+
+## Out of scope (separate follow-ups)
+
+- Space range-uniform "set all checked" (parity feature, not a bug).
+- Merged-cell glyph/hit-test mismatch.
+- Eager `FALSE` materialization for `COUNTIF`.
+- Custom checkbox values UI.

samples.summary: Unbounded `toUpperCase()` on attacker-controllable cell content in the per-repaint render path
samples.evidence: `isCheckboxChecked` now falls through to `value.toUpperCase() === CHECKBOX_TRUE` (data-validation.ts:166) for any value that is not exactly `TRUE`/`FALSE`. It is called from the canvas render loop for every visible checkbox cell (`packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1042`), i.e. on every repaint/scroll frame. The value is untrusted content: it can come from a collaborator's Yorkie edit, an xlsx import, or an external paste (the doc comment itself cites those sources), and I found no maximum cell-content length enforced in packages/sheets (grep for MaxCell/maxLength/MAX_CELL/MaxContentLength returned nothing). A collaborator who writes a multi-megabyte string into a cell covered by a default checkbox rule therefore causes a full-size string allocation + case mapping per such cell per frame in every viewer's renderer — a cheap, remote, low-grade resource-exhaustion/jank vector against other clients. The previous code compared references/strings only and never allocated. Hardening: short-circuit on `value.length !== CHECKBOX_TRUE.length && value.length !== CHECKBOX_FALSE.length` (or a small length cap) before calling `toUpperCase`. I did not measure whether other render-path work already dominates for huge cell values, hence low confidence.

samples.summary: No authorization weakening found: the new formula guard and case-folding do not bypass any read-only/permission gate
samples.evidence: I enumerated every caller of the operation the new guard protects. `Sheet.toggleCheckboxAt` (sheet.ts:3834) is reached from exactly three places: `Spreadsheet.toggleCheckboxAt` (spreadsheet.ts:363, gated by `this._readOnly` at line 364), the click path (worksheet.ts:3405, gated by `!this.readOnly` at line 3387) and the Space-key path (worksheet.ts:4853, gated by `!this.readOnly` at line 4847). `toggleCheckboxValue` has one non-test call site (sheet.ts:3845), and `isCheckboxChecked` one production call site (gridcanvas.ts:1042, render-only). No backend/API surface consumes these helpers (grep for dataValidation/checkedValue under packages/backend returned nothing), so no server-side trust decision depends on the relaxed string comparison. The `cell?.f` guard is a data-integrity/read-only-formula guard, not a permission gate, and adding it only narrows what the operation writes. The new docs/tasks file contains no text attempting to redirect review.
searchedFor: Read of worksheet.ts click (3380-3420) and Space (4820-4870) paths

samples.summary: New read-only guard covers `cell.f` but not spill ghost cells (`cell.spillAnchor`), so `toggleCheckboxAt` still reports `true` for a toggle `setData` silently drops
samples.evidence: `setData` already treats ghost cells as read-only and returns early: packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1004 (`if (existing?.spillAnchor) return;`). A checkbox rule over a cell filled by an array-formula spill has no `f` of its own (the `f` lives on the anchor), so the new guard at sheet.ts:3842 passes, `setData` at sheet.ts:3846 is a no-op, and `toggleCheckboxAt` returns `true`. Callers treat `true` as "the value changed" and re-render / report a toggle: packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:4853 and packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:365-367. The same design intent ("the formula drives the state") applies to ghost cells, so the guard should also check `cell?.spillAnchor`.

samples.summary: Click hit-test path still consumes the click on a formula-backed checkbox with no feedback now that the toggle silently returns false
samples.evidence: worksheet.ts:3402-3407 does `e.preventDefault(); finishEditing(); selectStart(ref); await toggleCheckboxAt(ref); this.render();` unconditionally — the return value is ignored, so a click on the glyph over a formula cell now does nothing visible (previously it toggled). The Space path (worksheet.ts:4853) likewise preventDefaults and then no-ops. Not a data bug, but two view entry points were written assuming the toggle always succeeds for a checkbox rule and were not updated (e.g. to keep a read-only cursor/hint).

samples.summary: Case-folded render now diverges from every other consumer of the stored value, which still compares case-sensitively
samples.evidence: `isCheckboxChecked` is only consumed by the renderer (gridcanvas.ts:1042) and `toggleCheckboxValue`, so after this change a cell holding `"true"` paints as checked while formulas/filters/COUNTIF over the raw string still see the literal `"true"` rather than the canonical `TRUE` (CHECKBOX_TRUE is used nowhere else in the repo — grep for CHECKBOX_TRUE|CHECKBOX_FALSE matches only data-validation.ts, index.ts and tests). The imported lowercase value is now displayed as checked but is not normalized anywhere, so display and value semantics disagree.
